clue.text: Period of debt various ancestors would limit

indicators.note: the words various ancestors hem in, or limit, a run of letters inside them that spans the word break

explanation.surface: A family history in which assorted forebears try to cap how long a loan may run.
explanation.definitionFit: Usance is the time allowed by custom for paying a bill of exchange, a fixed credit period.

clue.text: Arts graduate mugs up on new work rated very highly

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of mugs up on are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A humanities postgraduate crams up on a fresh piece of acclaimed writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' looks like part of the cramming but is simply fodder; 'new' is the only signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for great work, the phrase names an artist's finest or most acclaimed creation.

clue.text: Novice to seek charity — fallen one, no saint

parts.note: to beg is to ask for alms

indicators.note: no tells us the abbreviation for saint is dropped from the word for a fallen one

parts.note: a sinner is one who has fallen from grace

explanation.surface: A newcomer goes begging, a fallen soul and certainly no saint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no' removes S from SINNER, leaving INNER.
explanation.definitionFit: A novice is someone just starting out in an activity, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Undertaking is hard but not a thing to get excited about

indicators.note: not a says the letter A is taken away from the word for an undertaking

parts.note: a feat is a notable undertaking or exploit
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs that a tough task is no cause for excitement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes A from FEAT, leaving FET.
explanation.definitionFit: A fetish is an object of obsessive, often sexual, fixation, so something that arouses excitement.

clue.text: Having bottled up somewhat, escape minor inconvenience

indicators.note: having bottled up says the word for escape holds another piece inside it

parts.note: to flee is to escape
a bit means somewhat, to some degree

explanation.surface: Someone who has suppressed their feelings a little gets away from a small nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: Beyond the literal insect bite, the phrase is idiom for a trivial annoyance or slight hurt.

clue.text: Working for a while, covering brief time, is attractive

indicators.note: covering means the word for short-term work goes around another piece

parts.note: temping is doing temporary work
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: A temporary job that tides you over a short spell is appealing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tempting is alluring or appealing, a plain synonym of attractive.

clue.text: Scheme uses instrumental ensemble, including piano

indicators.note: including says the ensemble's name takes another piece within it

parts.note: a gamelan is an Indonesian orchestra of gongs and percussion
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A musical plan that uses an orchestra with a piano part.
explanation.definitionFit: A game plan is a strategy worked out in advance, so a scheme.

clue.text: Charge boy — nothing is admitted

indicators.note: is admitted means the zero symbol is let into the word for a boy

parts.note: a lad is a boy
O is the zero symbol, nothing

explanation.surface: A boy is accused, though nothing is confessed.
explanation.definitionFit: Charge and load both mean to fill, as a gun or battery is loaded or charged.

clue.text: Unfortunate youngster totally concentrated, they say

indicators.note: they say signals a word spoken that sounds like the entry

parts.note: a neat spirit is undiluted, fully concentrated

explanation.surface: A luckless youth is said to be utterly focused.
explanation.walkthrough: NEET stands for Not in Education, Employment or Training, a British label for jobless young people.
explanation.definitionFit: The acronym describes a young person outside school, work and training, so unfortunately placed.

clue.text: One enthroned — this person's in winter coat

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen on the throne
the setter's own, i.e. mine

explanation.surface: A monarch claims ownership of a coat for the cold season.
explanation.definitionFit: Ermine is the white winter fur of the stoat, worn on royal robes.

clue.text: End a life, sadly with discharge of gunfire

indicators.note: sadly says the letters of end a life are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: A grim scene: someone is killed by a burst of gunfire.
explanation.definitionFit: An enfilade is a volley of fire raking along a line of troops from end to end.

clue.text: Drink making miner with bottle sozzled

indicators.note: sozzled, drunk, suggests the letters of miner and bottle staggering into a new order

explanation.surface: A coal miner gets drunk on a bottle of something.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemon-flavoured soft drink with quinine, often a mixer.

clue.text: Fine material helping wound

parts.note: lace is a delicate openwork fabric
a ration is a portion or helping

explanation.surface: Delicate fabric used as a dressing for a cut.
explanation.definitionFit: A laceration is a jagged cut or tear in the flesh, a kind of injury.

clue.text: Assume I have to be encouraging

parts.note: to posit is to assume as a premise
contracted, I have becomes I've

explanation.surface: Someone presumes they must be supportive.
explanation.definitionFit: Positive feedback is hopeful and supportive, so encouraging.

clue.text: Freight brought into madame's is foreign food

indicators.note: brought into says the word for freight is placed inside another piece

parts.note: in French, madame is would be madame est, so the apostrophe-s gives est
cargo is freight carried by ship or plane

explanation.surface: Goods are delivered to a Frenchwoman's place of exotic cuisine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'madame's' reads as 'madame is', and French 'is' is EST.
explanation.definitionFit: Escargot is the French word for snail, eaten as a delicacy, so food from abroad.

clue.text: Religious writing's bit of magic not totally engaging worker

indicators.note: engaging means the shortened word holds the worker inside
not totally means the final letter of the word for a bit of magic is dropped

parts.note: a trick is a conjuring feat
an ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: A sacred text with a dash of sorcery, not quite hiring a labourer.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is possessive because tantric is an adjective: of or belonging to the tantras.
explanation.definitionFit: Tantric means relating to the tantras, Hindu and Buddhist mystical scriptures, so belonging to such writings.

clue.text: Agonised about record, being stuffed once more

indicators.note: about places the word for agonised around the record

parts.note: racked means tormented or agonised
EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: Someone tormented over a record that is being crammed in again.
explanation.definitionFit: To repack is to fill a bag or case again, so stuffed a second time.

clue.text: Standard disciples — or those specially called?

parts.note: par is the standard or norm
followers are called sons, as in the sons of the prophets

explanation.surface: A question about whether ordinary followers are the specially chosen.
explanation.definitionFit: Clergy are said to have a calling or vocation, so parish priests are those with a special call.

clue.text: Nasty Tories digging into benefit with a particular economic policy

indicators.note: digging into means the jumbled party goes inside the word for benefit

parts.note: a perk is a benefit of a job

indicators.note: nasty suggests the letters of Tories turned into a mess

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Mean Conservatives burrow into welfare payments as part of their economic agenda.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nasty' looks like comment on the party but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Perestroika was Gorbachev's restructuring of the Soviet economy in the 1980s, a specific policy.

clue.text: Come and attract men to the north

indicators.note: to the north, in a down entry, means the pieces read upward, backwards

parts.note: to pull is to attract
OR, other ranks, are soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: An invitation to come and lure soldiers up north.
explanation.definitionFit: Roll up is a showman's call to approach, an idiom meaning come along.

clue.text: Aid to identification when one probes newt

indicators.note: probes means the numeral pokes into the word for newt

parts.note: an eft is a newt
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An investigator's prod at a newt helps identify it.
explanation.definitionFit: An E-fit is a computer-generated face likeness built from witness memory, used to identify suspects.

clue.text: To drink noisily, not quietly, is an insult

indicators.note: not tells us the quiet letter is removed from the word for loud drinking

parts.note: to slurp is to drink with a loud sucking sound
P stands for piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: Gulping down a drink loudly rather than discreetly is rude.
explanation.definitionFit: A slur is a disparaging remark, a slight against someone's reputation.

clue.text: Joy, female priest joining urban area

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Book of Samuel
a city is a large urban area

explanation.surface: A woman priest delights in joining a town.
explanation.definitionFit: Felicity is intense happiness or bliss, a synonym of joy.

clue.text: With intervention of hubby ultimately, affair is in the air

indicators.note: with intervention of says a letter comes into the middle of the word for affair

parts.note: a fling is a brief affair

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of hubby

explanation.surface: A husband stepping in at last, when an affair is rumoured.
explanation.definitionFit: Flying means aloft, airborne, literally in the air.

clue.text: What could indicate a limited number being really excited

parts.words: What could indicate a limited number
parts.note: read as an instruction, the answer turns the word on around to give no, a shortened number

explanation.surface: Something that might signal a small count, being thrilled.
explanation.walkthrough: NO is a short form of number, a limited number; the entry read as an instruction reverses ON to NO.
explanation.definitionFit: Turned on is idiom for aroused or keenly stimulated, so highly excited.

clue.text: Fighting prince, game and jaunty

parts.note: RU is rugby union
pert means lively and jaunty

explanation.surface: A warrior prince who is sporty and perky.
explanation.walkthrough: Prince Rupert of the Rhine was a dashing Royalist cavalry commander in the English Civil War.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs to a famous seventeenth-century cavalry general, a warlike royal.
